discussion:
# Principle

Personnel are provided with ongoing cyber security awareness training, including operational security considerations, tailored to their duties, access levels and current cyber threats.

# Indicators of Good Practice

Not effective:
- No requirement exists for personnel to complete cyber security awareness training before being granted access to critical, privileged or business systems.
- No training completion records are maintained.

Partially effective:
- A training program exists but is not tailored to the specific risks of the systems in-scope.
- A requirement to complete training before access is granted exists but is not consistently enforced.
- Completion records are maintained but show significant gaps in coverage.

Fully effective:
- Role-tailored training programs address the specific risks, data handling obligations and incident reporting requirements relevant to in-scope systems.
- All personnel complete role-tailored training before being granted access to organisational systems and data, with refresher training mandated within a cycle defined by the organisation.
- Completion records are maintained and demonstrate full coverage.
title: Ensure all personnel receive cyber security awareness training, that is tailored to how they will interact with systems, applications and data in their assigned roles, before being granted access to organisational systems and data.
